note: Official sources only. Versions resolve at install time from the source (latest release, or the version a project pins in production/tools.json); checksums come from the source (GitHub asset digests, Blender's .sha256 file). A source without a published checksum is installed with checksum 'unpublished' recorded.

blender.title: Blender
blender.macos_instruction: Download blender-{version}-macos-arm64.dmg from https://www.blender.org/download/ and drag Blender into Applications.
blender.after: Start Blender with --online-mode (the Blender Lab add-on needs online access).

git-lfs.title: Git LFS (large binary assets in git)
git-lfs.after: Add its folder to PATH for git (the installer prints it), then `git lfs install --local` in the project.

ollama.title: Ollama (local language models for LLM NPCs)
ollama.linux_instruction: Linux: the official package is a .tar.zst (https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases) or the install script from https://ollama.com/download/linux; Kiln does not pipe a script into the shell.
ollama.after: Pull the model the llm-npc skill names (`ollama pull <model>`); the serve process listens on 127.0.0.1:11434.

godot-ai.title: Godot AI MCP server
godot-ai.after: Register it: `claude mcp add --scope user godot-ai -- <path> attach`; the editor addon is the tool godot-ai-addon.

godot-ai-addon.title: Godot AI editor addon
godot-ai-addon.after: Link <install dir>/addons/godot_ai into the project (setup step 4). godot-ai-plugin.zip is the Migration plugin, not this one.

blender-mcp.title: Blender Lab MCP server and add-on
blender-mcp.after: Install the add-on: `<blender> --command extension install-file -r user_default -e <mcp-{version}.zip>`; never PyPI blender_mcp (a different server with the same name).

unity.title: Unity 6 editor
unity.instruction: Unity needs a Unity account and a licence, so Kiln does not install it. 1) Install Unity Hub from https://unity.com/download and sign in. 2) Installs → Install Editor → the Unity 6 LTS version the project names, with the Build Support modules for your target platforms. 3) Tell Kiln when it is done; it finds the editor under Hub/Editor/ and carries on (setup step 4).

unreal.title: Unreal Engine 5.8
unreal.instruction: Unreal needs an Epic Games account and its EULA, so Kiln does not install it. 1) Install the Epic Games Launcher from https://store.epicgames.com/download and sign in. 2) Unreal Engine → Library → + → Unreal Engine 5.8 → Install (C++ projects also need Visual Studio 2022 with the 'Game development with C++' workload). 3) Tell Kiln when it is done; it finds UnrealEditor.exe and carries on (setup step 4).

unity-mcp.title: MCP for Unity (package + server)
unity-mcp.project_edit: Packages/manifest.json dependencies: "com.coplaydev.unity-mcp": "https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp.git?path=/MCPForUnity#v{version}" (before the editor first opens the project)
unity-mcp.after: In the editor: Window → MCP for Unity → start the HTTP server; tool groups core, testing, scripting_ext, profiling (asset_gen off).

unreal-mcp.title: Unreal MCP (Epic, UE 5.8)
unreal-mcp.project_edit: <project>.uproject Plugins entries {"Name": <n>, "Enabled": true} for ModelContextProtocol (Epic's Unreal MCP), AllToolsets and PythonScriptPlugin, before the first open (engine-unreal skill)
unreal-mcp.after: Editor preferences: MCP auto-start on, port 8000, path /mcp.

triposr.title: TripoSR
triposr.makes: rough shape with vertex colours from 1 image
triposr.quality: low: a blockout to clean up; a wide crop (head + neck + collar) works better than a tight face
triposr.speed: ~40 s model + ~40 s mesh on CPU

triposg.title: TripoSG
triposg.makes: shape only from 1 image (texture by projection in Blender)
triposg.quality: good shapes for organic props and characters on an 8 GB GPU
triposg.speed: under a minute on a mid GPU

sf3d.title: Stable Fast 3D
sf3d.makes: textured mesh with de-lit albedo from 1 image
sf3d.licence: Stability AI Community: free under $1M annual revenue

step1x-3d.title: Step1X-3D
step1x-3d.speed: minutes; rented GPU on most machines (model_generators=remote)

trellis2.title: TRELLIS.2
trellis2.makes: high-resolution shape + PBR textures from 1 image
trellis2.licence: MIT + DINOv3 licence for the image encoder
trellis2.speed: minutes; Linux, so a rented GPU on Windows (model_generators=remote)

spar3d.title: SPAR3D (Stable Point-Aware 3D)
spar3d.makes: UV-unwrapped textured GLB with roughness/metallic from 1 image; remesh to tris or quads
spar3d.terms: free commercial use under US$1M annual revenue, registration required
spar3d.quality: clean game-ready props in seconds; low-VRAM mode about 7 GB (10.5 GB default)

pixal3d.title: Pixal3D (Tencent ARC)
pixal3d.makes: GLB with PBR from 1 image or several views (multi-view since 2026-09)
pixal3d.quality: high detail, uses all 1-3 input views; VRAM not published, --low_vram at 1024
pixal3d.speed: about a minute on a 24 GB GPU (not published)

ace-step-1.5.title: ACE-Step 1.5
ace-step-1.5.makes: full songs or instrumentals from a text prompt and optional lyrics, up to 10 min, 50+ languages
ace-step-1.5.terms: model card: outputs may be used commercially; trained on licensed, royalty-free and synthetic data
ace-step-1.5.quality: the best open music model that fits a small GPU
ace-step-1.5.speed: under 10 s per song on an RTX 3090

diffrhythm.title: DiffRhythm 1.2
diffrhythm.makes: full songs from lyrics (LRC) and a style prompt or reference, or instrumentals, up to 4:45
diffrhythm.quality: second choice: song structure from timed lyrics

not_offered.hunyuan3d: licence excludes the EU, the UK and South Korea and covers the output; 2.5 and later are hosted only
not_offered.yue: weights CC BY-NC 4.0; only individuals may monetise outputs, companies need a licence
not_offered.stable-audio-open: 47 s clips, weak on music (sound effects fit better); Stability Community Licence
